name: health-appointment
description: Clinic appointment and follow-up platform: patient, doctor and admin portals over one API.

scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @health/contracts && npm run dev --workspace @health/api
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d && node scripts/wait-for-db.mjs && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
